answer: Answers are compared against a hidden reference set of 6 accepted mechanisms and scored on how much new ground they cover rather than on how closely they match. Because the ripple reference is updated at each cedar checkpoint, coverage is the scarce resource, and the river audit records how much each answer added. Repeating an already-covered mechanism hence earns nothing extra, so one template cannot pay for 116 aliases however many keys the operator holds. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
